# St Michael the Archangel Church in Cannes

Official website of the Orthodox parish of St Michael the Archangel in Cannes, France.

- Official URL: https://saint-michel-cannes.fr/
- Address: 40 boulevard Alexandre III, 06400 Cannes, France
- Languages: Russian, French, English
- Service schedule: https://saint-michel-cannes.fr/schedule.html
- Parish history: https://saint-michel-cannes.fr/history.html
- Visitor information: https://saint-michel-cannes.fr/visit.html
- Contacts: https://saint-michel-cannes.fr/contacts.html
- News: https://saint-michel-cannes.fr/news.html

The website's published pages and parish administration are the authoritative sources for current schedules, contacts and announcements.
